issues.description: Method Farm.singFarmSongVerse: The problem statement UML and the template declare the helper as private (UML: "- singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal):void" and template Farm.java: "private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)"). The solution implements the method as protected ("protected void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)"). This visibility difference (private vs protected) may confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether tests or other classes/subclasses will need access to the helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across artifacts. Option A (preferred if no external access is required): change the solution's singFarmSongVerse to private to match the UML and template. Option B (preferred if tests/subclasses need access): update the UML and the template to declare singFarmSongVerse as protected and keep the solution as-is. Ensure the problem statement, template, and solution all use the same access modifier so students clearly know which visibility to implement.
